body_lead: Home |Hyderabad |Telangana Ai Powered Personalised Learning Labs Launched In 24 Government Schools Telangana: AI-powered personalised learning labs launched in 24 government schools Cognizant Foundation, in collaboration with Educational Initiatives (Ei) and State government, launched 'Ei Mindspark,' an artificial intelligence-enabled personalized and adaptive learning tool.
